paper: MadEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization of Trading Systems with Large Language Models
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of MadEvolve Run 5 that jointly evolves a feature program and a score-shaping strategy wrapper through five quality-diversity islands; not the missing BTCUSD code, LLM mutations, evolved program, minute-bar simulator, or native results.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Headline Run 5 jointly exposes the feature pipeline and execution strategy to evolution, refits the forecaster on training data, optimizes validation impact-adjusted PnL, and freezes the validation champion for test.
Parent and inspiration programs generate approximately 70% differential patches and 30% rewrites; candidates enter a quality-diversity population after automated evaluation.
Five semi-isolated MAP-Elites populations migrate 10% of elites every five generations while a global archive preserves top programs.
Validation PnL with embedded costs is the fitness objective; parameter changes live inside evolved programs, and held-out test performance is not used for selection.
The best joint program combines multi-scale price features, volatility, range, order-flow interactions, regime-conditioned risk reduction, and nonlinear conviction shaping.

candidate_library.feature_transform: monthly cross-sectional rank to [-1,1] before identities, pair means, and products
candidate_library.training_fit: orient and weight selected terms by diagonal-ridge-shrunk mean monthly RankIC over the training window

evolution_policy.fitness: compounded validation long-short return after target-to-target turnover at 10 bp one-way
evolution_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the frozen program's continuous score enters fixed value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

preserved_elements: joint evolution of feature and strategy code concepts
validation economic-return fitness with embedded costs
migration every five generations at a 10% rate
validation champion frozen out of sample
approximated_elements: monthly JKP characteristics replace BTCUSD minute bars and order-book state
deterministic symbolic mutations replace the unavailable frontier-LLM ensemble
RankIC-derived term weights replace candidate-specific ridge forecasting code
score wrappers replace limit-order placement, fill, inventory, and impact logic
48/24/24-month rolling windows replace the single 2022-2023/2024/2025 split
common decile turnover costs replace exchange fees and nonlinear market impact
fixed program descriptors replace source-code embeddings and character length
invented_elements: the five score wrappers and their formulas
15 generations with two offspring per island
the exact initial island seeds and deterministic mutation operators
